question: What happens to sin committed elsewhere when one reaches a sacred tīrtha?
premises: Yad pāpaṃ anyatra kṛtaṃ refers to sin committed elsewhere.
Tīrthe locates the effect at a sacred tīrtha.
Yāti lāghavam states that it goes to lightness.
inference: Sin committed elsewhere becomes lightened at a sacred tīrtha.
plain_english: Sin that has been committed elsewhere becomes lightened at a sacred tīrtha.
